_comment: Copy this file to settings.json and edit. active_project/active_service are
managed by `sidekicks project use` / `sidekicks service use` — do not hand-edit them.
THIS FILE IS STATE, NOT CONFIGURATION. It records which project and service are active
on THIS machine, and nothing else. Configuration lives in the scope's config/ directory,
one file per family — see docs/guide/configuration.md.
MOVED: `persistent_agent_memory` used to live here and now is the `agent_memory` block in
the root scope's config/agents.yaml, resolved like every other config block:
sidekicks config get agent_memory          # what is configured, and which layer decided it
sidekicks config where agent_memory        # which file to edit
It was a durable, shareable decision parked inside a git-ignored per-machine file, so half
of it could never travel with the repo. The old key is still READ as a deprecated fallback,
so a machine that has not migrated keeps its journal — but write the block instead.
An optional `framework` block is still honored here: it is the per-machine layer of the
framework enable map (`sidekicks framework disable <id>` writes the committed team default
in config/framework.yaml; this file is how you turn one off on your laptop only).
